item.title: Executives trust AI more than their own judgment, survey finds
item.description: A survey released Wednesday morning found executives are twice as likely as rank-and-file workers to trust AI over their own judgment. The finding highlights a growing reliance on AI in decision-making.

item.title: AI models sometimes refuse to assist in fighting hackers
item.description: Security teams facing AI-enabled cyber threats encounter a new obstacle: the AI models they use to investigate attacks can refuse to cooperate.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO timing is not optional, investors say
item.description: Anthropic's upcoming IPO will test a nervous Wall Street, but investors say the timing is not optional. The AI company faces simple math that makes delay costly.
